legacy_accounting_note: The tsshd#1 source artifacts predate per-direction shared-queue accounting. For shared=true, up and down mirror one physical queue; aggregate calculations use one section exactly once. Artifacts emitted by the current harness contain truthful up/down sections plus relay.aggregate.
seeded_suite_note: budget-*.json suite artifacts are generated by TSSHD_CTRL_BENCH at seed 20260916; each contains three independently re-executed process runs. Absolute CLOCK_MONOTONIC timestamps are comparable only within a run. Runs share the RNG seed but KCP scheduling and wall-clock effects vary. Bulk suites are bidirectional with PTY echo disabled in the child; the canonical-mode line discipline (~4 KB per line) bounds the uplink figure, so it measures a canonical-PTY session uplink, not the raw transport. The one-way legacy 2.68x clean amplification figure is not a direct threshold for the bidirectional bulk family.
row_1_re_anchor_note: The tsshd#1 single-shot figures were fixed-phase draws that never sampled the pinned-full-queue tail; the 30-sample harness-v2 suites measure it (paste transit + kcp RTO backoff, ACK-starvation tails). Rows were re-anchored to [committed-v2] envelopes per design section 7 gate discipline, with the evidence trail below and on the tsshd#3 work-item timeline. Pre-fix observations 5442.6 / 5411.1 / 5391.5 ms documented the marker-write blocking defect fixed in ctrlChildFloodCount ([superseded-defect]).

tsshd6_campaign.note: Same-pin before (P1-off, shipped default) and after (P1-on @ recipe: --kcp-wire-rate 175000 at the 2 Mbps reference; 25000000 on the clean 100 Mbps case) suites, 3 seeded runs each, seed 20260916. amp_estimate tightened 2.2 -> 2.6 with evidence recorded on the tsshd#6 timeline; the row-5 formula floor is 0.8 x 175,000 / 2.6 = 53,846 B/s (430.8 kbps) - the campaign note that evaluated it at the tested amp 3.4 was corrected with the same evidence. p1 degraded bulk variants bound the uplink source to 8 KB/s; the p1offq_* matched-stimulus references run the same cases with the same bounded uplink and pacing OFF for the controlled attribution. integrity_diff_bytes is json-omitempty: absent means 0.

row-1-p1 input delivery.result: PASS 3/3 every case (derived: per-run ctrl p95 <= envelope+10%)

row-2-p1 visible confirmation drain.result: FAIL 0/6 at the 1.5 s design target (and not citable: truncated marker prefix)
row-2-p1 visible confirmation drain.comment: Only a minority of markers arrive within the post-sample marker drain (kcp RTO-backoff tail losses with no follow-on traffic to trigger fast resend); the prefix p95 already exceeds the 1.5 s target, and the citability gate fails the runs independently. Root-cause decomposition on the tsshd#6 timeline: child-side marker fd starvation + proportional delivery deficit at 20% loss accumulating in the kcp send queue + sparse-tail RTO backoff; the remainder is out of tsshd#6 non-goals and is owned by tsshd#13 (kcp-level loss-recovery work, filed from the tsshd#6 review_fix step; the 1.5 s gate itself stays enforced, never relaxed)

matched_stimulus_attribution.comment: Controlled attribution (same 8 KB/s uplink both sides): shared improves under pacing (median 53248 -> 68796 B/s); split is CAPPED by the recipe at the 67308 B/s offer while the matched unpaced case reaches 107725 B/s - the weak-link recipe deliberately under-provisions the split topology (its per-direction queue has no downlink/uplink contention); the wi gate binds split at the formula floor + committed parity, and the trade-off is recorded here as the honest cost of the recipe
